units.source_text: 约莫五点半，我从中学回到家里。

en.t: At about half past five, I came home from middle school.

units.source_text: 我家大门紧闭着，避免客人来访，因为只有祖父躺在家中，来人不好招待。

en.t: The front gate of our house was kept tightly shut to keep visitors away, because only my grandfather was lying at home and it would have been hard to receive guests.

units.source_text: （祖父患白内障，那时候已双目失明。）

en.t: (My grandfather had cataracts, and by then he had already lost sight in both eyes.)
